name: Dialog
import: import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogBody, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogTrigger, DialogClose, DialogPortal, DialogOverlay } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/dialog';
whenToUse: A short, focused task that needs an answer before going on: rename, invite, a form of a few fields.
When leaving the page for it would lose context.

whenNotToUse.text: Long forms, or content people compare with the page
A message that needs no answer
Extra detail next to a control

anatomy.description: top right; `showCloseButton` to hide it when the footer has Cancel.

do.caption: Title names the task; the primary button repeats the verb.
do.example: <DialogMock title="Invite people" actions={<><Button appearance="outlined" tone="secondary" size="md">Cancel</Button><Button size="md">Send invites</Button></>} />

dont.caption: “Are you sure?” + Yes/No says nothing about what will happen.
dont.example: <DialogMock title="Are you sure?" actions={<><Button appearance="outlined" tone="secondary" size="md">No</Button><Button size="md">Yes</Button></>} />

do.caption: Small and finishable in one go.
do.example: <DialogMock title="Rename database" actions={<><Button appearance="outlined" tone="secondary" size="md">Cancel</Button><Button size="md">Rename</Button></>}>One field, one decision.</DialogMock>

dont.caption: A wizard in a dialog: no room, no URL, easy to lose with one Escape.
dont.example: <DialogMock title="Edit site settings" actions={<Button size="md">Next</Button>}>Step 1 of 6 — General, Domains, Environment, Build, SSL, Backups…</DialogMock>

a11y: Focus moves into the dialog on open, stays inside while it’s open, and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape closes. `DialogTitle` is required — it’s the dialog’s accessible name.
Don’t open a dialog from another dialog.
The first focus goes to the first field, or to the least destructive action when there’s no field.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between the header, body, and footer sections: `md` (default), `sm`, or `none`.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show the separator line between the header and dialog content.

components.name: DialogBody
components.description:
The scrolling middle region. Required for `size="full"` (that variant
clips its own overflow, so the body owns the scroll and header + footer
stay pinned). The default centered variant scrolls as one box, so plain
padded content works there too. `showDivider` draws the same inset line
used elsewhere, for form dialogs where the body should be visually
separated from the footer.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show the separator line between dialog content and the footer.
